# Computing $P(X_5 > 0 \mid W_3 = 1)$

## Setting Up the Conditional Probability

Since $X_5 = W_5^2 - 5$, the event $X_5 > 0$ is equivalent to $W_5^2 > 5$, i.e., $|W_5| > \sqrt{5}$.

**Using the Markov property:** Given $W_3 = 1$, I can decompose:
$$W_5 = W_3 + (W_5 - W_3) = 1 + \Delta, \quad \text{where } \Delta \sim N(0, 2)$$

The variance of the increment is $5 - 3 = 2$, so $\Delta = \sqrt{2}\,Z$ with $Z \sim N(0,1)$.

## Breaking into Two Tail Events

$$P(|1 + \Delta| > \sqrt{5}) = P(1+\Delta > \sqrt{5}) + P(1+\Delta < -\sqrt{5})$$

**First term:**
$$P(\Delta > \sqrt{5}-1) = P\!\left(Z > \frac{\sqrt{5}-1}{\sqrt{2}}\right) = 1 - \Phi\!\left(\frac{\sqrt{5}-1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)$$

**Second term:**
$$P(\Delta < -\sqrt{5}-1) = P\!\left(Z < -\frac{\sqrt{5}+1}{\sqrt{2}}\right) = 1 - \Phi\!\left(\frac{\sqrt{5}+1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)$$

## Evaluating the Standard Normal CDF

Computing the $z$-values:
$$z_1 = \frac{\sqrt{5}-1}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{1.23607}{1.41421} \approx 0.8740$$
$$z_2 = \frac{\sqrt{5}+1}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{3.23607}{1.41421} \approx 2.2882$$

Looking up the CDF values:
$$\Phi(0.8740) \approx 0.8089$$
$$\Phi(2.2882) \approx 0.9889$$

## Final Computation

$$P = \bigl[1 - \Phi(z_1)\bigr] + \bigl[1 - \Phi(z_2)\bigr]$$

$$P = (1 - 0.8089) + (1 - 0.9889) = 0.1911 + 0.0111 = 0.2021$$

$$\boxed{0.2021}$$
